THE WEEKEND READER

A morning walk by the river

Five minutes to read

Every morning I walk the dog along the river before the town wakes up. The water is still, and a cat watches us from the bridge.

At the corner café my friend has a book open and two cups waiting. We talk about the week, the weather and the house we want to paint.

By the time the sun is high, the dog is tired, my friend says thanks for the company, and the river is full of boats.
